notes_en: Live Recitation mic fix: frames are no longer dropped during the start/sink race. Native audio is buffered until the Flutter listener attaches, then flushed, so mic chunks and bytes sent both flow (fixes 'mic chunks: 0 · bytes sent: 0' silent capture).
notes_ur: لائیو تلاوت فکس: اب شروعات کے دوران آڈیو فریم ضائع نہیں ہوتے اور مائیک کا ڈیٹا سرور تک پہنچتا ہے۔
notes_hi: Live Recitation fix: mic audio frames are buffered until the listener attaches, so they reach the server instead of being dropped.
